# perch

- **Commit:** `47ce905fd63848e8be2d0a356f479a9734e13766`
- **Licence:** MIT

## Why we vendor it

Perch is the closest prior art to Belay's v0.1: a Swift notch app that answers Claude Code and Codex prompts.

| Upstream file | What we take | Belay destination | Feature |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Sources/Perch/HookServer.swift` | Unix-socket hook server that holds `PermissionRequest` until answered; `HookInstaller` (the `curl --unix-socket` hook shim, per-agent event and timeout table, idempotent install/uninstall of our entries in `~/.claude/settings.json` and `~/.codex/hooks.json`) | **Port to TypeScript** in `core/packages/belayd` (HookGateway, Installer) and `core/packages/belayd/shim/belay-hook` | A1, A2, H1, ADR 0006 |
| `Sources/PerchCore/LiveStatus.swift` | Hook-event parsing: "what the agent wants" lines; `plainCommand` (strip `2>&1`, `\| tail` plumbing); Codex `["bash","-lc",…]` unwrapping | **Port to TypeScript** in Adapters and Narrator | A1, A2, A5 |
| `Sources/Perch/Terminals.swift` | Finding and focusing the terminal window/tab that owns a session (iTerm2, Terminal.app, others) | **Adapt in Swift** at `apps/mac/Belay/MacBridge/WindowLocator.swift` | A7, A8 |
| `Sources/PerchCore/NotchGeometry.swift` | Notch rectangle and hit-testing per screen | **Adapt in Swift** at `apps/mac/Belay/Notch/` (alongside DynamicNotchKit) | A1, B8 |
| `Sources/PerchCore/NotchMachine.swift` | Notch open/closed/hover state machine | Reference for `apps/mac/Belay/Notch/` | E3 |

**Findings to verify (ADR 0006):**
- Perch registers Codex `PermissionRequest` with a **5 s** timeout, versus 3600 s for Claude Code.
- Claude Code questions in bypass mode arrive on a `PreToolUse` hook with matcher `AskUserQuestion`, not on `PermissionRequest`.

**Rules:** files here stay byte-identical to upstream. Adapted copies carry a header:
`// Adapted from Perch (MIT), <upstream path> @ 47ce905f. See third_party/perch/.`
